statements.sql:
SELECT
          id,
          name,
          type,
          status,
          currency,
          balance_amount,
          debt_balance_amount,
          credit_limit_amount,
          institution_name,
          description,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        FROM accounts
        ORDER BY name ASC;

SELECT amount, type, direction FROM transactions
         WHERE date >= ? AND date < ? AND status = ?
           AND substr(date, 1, ?) = ? AND ((type = ? AND direction = ?) OR (type = ? AND direction = ?))
         ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC;

SELECT
          id,
          name,
          type,
          status,
          currency,
          balance_amount,
          debt_balance_amount,
          credit_limit_amount,
          institution_name,
          description,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        FROM accounts
        ORDER BY name ASC;

SELECT amount, type, direction, CASE
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shared_receipts r WHERE r.transaction_id = transactions.id AND r.status = 'active')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shared_returns r WHERE r.transaction_id = transactions.id AND r.status = 'active') THEN 0
  ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.amount_minor / 100.0 FROM shared_expenses e
    JOIN transaction_splits s ON s.shared_expense_id = e.id AND s.shared_active = 1 AND s.contact_id IS NULL
    WHERE e.transaction_id = transactions.id AND e.status = 'active'), amount) END AS personal_amount FROM transactions
         WHERE COALESCE(civil_date, substr(date, 1, 10)) >= ? AND COALESCE(civil_date, substr(date, 1, 10)) < ? AND status = ?
           AND substr(COALESCE(civil_date, substr(date, 1, 10)), 1, ?) = ? AND ((type = ? AND direction = ?) OR (type = ? AND direction = ?))
         ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC;
SELECT * FROM shared_contacts ORDER BY id;
SELECT * FROM shared_expenses ORDER BY id;
SELECT * FROM transaction_splits WHERE shared_expense_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id;
SELECT * FROM shared_receipts ORDER BY id;
SELECT * FROM shared_allocations ORDER BY id;
SELECT * FROM shared_returns ORDER BY id;
